environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as an OCI container on GCP Cloud Run (gen2) with the following runtime configuration: the container entrypoint invokes the binary via a wrapper script that calls pivot_root(2) into /app/sandbox (a minimal tmpfs overlay containing only the JVM/native-image runtime libs and an empty /app/workspace tree). The container spec sets 'securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: false' but the Cloud Run service revision has a volume mount configuration where the only writable volume is a tmpfs mounted at /app/workspace with 512Mi limit and 'no-suid,no-dev' mount options. The service uses Cloud Run's second-generation execution environment which provides a full Linux kernel with gVisor (runsc) as the OCI runtime, and the container's /proc/1/root resolves to /app/sandbox after pivot_root. Files outside /app/sandbox (including /etc, /usr, /bin, /var) are not present in the mount namespace. The workspace tmpfs contains no sensitive data, credentials, or configuration - secrets are injected exclusively via Cloud Run secret manager references mapped to environment variables, never to filesystem paths.

config.secrets_delivery: environment variables via Secret Manager, no filesystem secret mounts
config.readonly_paths_outside_workspace: all paths outside /app/workspace are either absent or read-only runtime libraries
